evidence: driverdan uses OpenSpec with PRs at proposal, apply, and archive stages, and values its retrospective specifications and task checklist.

evidence_sources.author: driverdan
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use the OpenSpec[1] workflow with PRs at each step, proposal, apply, archive. I have the LLM do those steps but I review the results and have it make changes as needed. OpenSpec specs make it easy to look back at what it was supposed to do if necessary, including a checklist of tasks.

source_story_title: How I Fight AI Brain Fry
